# Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Release Notes — captured 2026-08-07
# Source used: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock-agentcore/latest/devguide/release-notes.html
# (doc-history.html still renders title/nav only — recurring since 2026-05-18)

## August 2026 [ALL NEW THIS SCAN — REPORTED 2026-08-07]
- **Runtime: Instances compute type with capacity providers** — agents run on AWS-managed EC2 in the
  customer's own account. Capacity provider defines OS, allowed instance types, networking, storage.
  Persistent sessions up to 14 days; GPU instance types; MULTIPLE AGENTS CAN SHARE ONE INSTANCE.
  Linux x86_64/arm64 at launch. Savings Plans / ODCR apply.
  -> new data-plane op observed: DeleteCapacityProviderSession
- **AWS Agent Registry launches under the new `agent-registry` namespace** (was preview under
  bedrock-agentcore; namespace move effective Aug 6, 2026). Private governed catalog of agents,
  tools, skills, MCP servers, custom resources. Exposed via console, control-plane + data-plane APIs,
  and the registry's own MCP endpoint. New: ListDiscoverableRegistryRecords,
  BatchGetDiscoverableRegistryRecord, record tagging, required `recordType`, Record directory console
  page. Validates definitions against MCP and A2A schemas. Per-registry authorization config +
  approval config (manual review before a record becomes discoverable). Nine AWS Regions.
- **Gateway: Configurable rate limits** — customer-defined limits scoped by dimensionKeys/entries over
  JWT claims ($.context.jwt.sub), IAM principals (iam.sourceIdentity), target names, tool names,
  qualified model IDs. Metrics: Requests (RPS/RPM), Tokens (TPM), Connections. Wildcard catch-all;
  most-specific-match-wins; AND semantics across limits; effective = min(service, customer);
  rate=0 = explicit block. Fails OPEN on transient errors. Propagates in ~30s.
  Six new ops: CreateRateLimit, GetRateLimit, UpdateRateLimit, DeleteRateLimit, ListRateLimits,
  BatchPutRateLimitEntries.

## July 2026 [ALL NEW THIS SCAN]
- **Gateway Web Search connector v1.2.0** — target-level domain INCLUDE list added alongside exclude;
  both raised 20 -> 100 domains. Request-level `filters` on tools/call: domainFilter.include/exclude
  (100 each) and publishedDateFilter from/to. [REPORTED]
- **Identity: Private Key JWT client authentication** — signed JWT client assertion instead of a shared
  OAuth client secret; private key stays in AWS KMS, every signing op in CloudTrail. Works across M2M,
  OBO, and user-delegated flows; RS256/PS256/ES256. [REPORTED]
- **Harness: InvokeHarness streams MCP tool result metadata** — new `toolResultMetadata` delta channel;
  large metadata auto-split into ordered fragments. [REPORTED]
- **Runtime: Unified span destination** — spans go to the agent's own CloudWatch log group
  (/aws/bedrock-agentcore/runtimes/<agent_id>-<endpoint_name>, `spans` stream) instead of shared
  aws/spans. UNIFIED_TRACES_DESTINATION_ENABLED; DEFAULT for agents created on/after Jul 20, 2026. [REPORTED]
- **Evaluations: expanded agent framework support** — OpenAI Agents, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, Claude
  Agent SDK (plus existing Strands, LangGraph) + generic OTel GenAI / OpenInference framework support. [REPORTED]
- Evaluations and Optimizations: AWS PrivateLink support (com.amazonaws.region.bedrock-agentcore). [below bar]
- Runtime and Built-in Tools: ActiveSessionCount CloudWatch metric, AWS/Bedrock-AgentCore namespace,
  Service dimension = AgentCore.Runtime | CodeInterpreter | Browser. [below bar]

## June 2026 [already cached — reported 2026-07-05]
- Runtime increased default service quotas; Web Search Tool GA; AgentCore Policy + Bedrock Guardrails;
  Managed Knowledge Base; new Gateway target types; Runtime Interactive Shells.

Updated: 2026-08-07 — First July AND August sections since the page was adopted. Eight reportable items.
